title: Popups, Context Menus and Modals
summary: Popups are small windows that appear on request and close when you click elsewhere - right-click menus, pickers, confirmations. This lesson explains ImGui's popup model (open by ID, draw every frame while open), context menus on items and windows, modal dialogs that block the rest of the interface, and the classic "unsaved changes" confirmation.
ideas:
- Add a right-click menu to each stone in your list, with Rename and Delete.
- Add the "Unsaved changes" modal to Quit and New level, with Save, Don't save and Cancel.

cards.a: A popup has an ID; OpenPopup marks it open once, and BeginPopup, called every frame, returns true and draws it while it is open; it closes on outside clicks, Escape, selectables or CloseCurrentPopup.

cards.q: What do BeginPopupContextItem and BeginPopupContextWindow do?
cards.a: They open and begin a popup when the item just drawn, or empty space in the window, is right-clicked.

cards.q: How do you centre a modal each time it appears?
cards.a: SetNextWindowPos at the main viewport's centre, with pivot (0.5, 0.5) and ImGuiCond_Appearing.
